name: Stillwater Team Scramble
oneLiner: Stillwater's first Winter league season: a two-person team scramble where every team plays every other team each week for points, 9 holes at a time on a course that changes each week.
beginnerNote: A scramble is the friendliest format there is: you both hit, you take the better ball and go again. Nine holes takes about two hours, and both men and women are welcome.
night: Sundays 5:00pm, Monday thru Thursday 6:00pm — you play the same night every week
format: 2-person team scramble against the field, with all teams playing all other teams from every other night for points. Handicapped. 9 holes, course varies week to week, about 2 hours.
startDate: Week of January 10th and runs through week of April 11th. 14 weeks: 12 regular season, 2 play-off/fun nights.
prizes: Prizes dependent on size of League, in the form of gift cards from The Links of Lakeville
